findings.current: An area several hundred meters across, centered on the spot where I had been standing only a few seconds earlier, had been reduced to ruins.
findings.defect: The draft changes a radius of several hundred meters into a total width of several hundred meters, substantially reducing the stated blast area.
findings.replacement: The area within a radius of several hundred meters, centered on the spot where I had been standing only a few seconds earlier, had been devastated.
findings.source: 불과 몇 초 전, 내가 서 있던 자리를 중심으로 반경 수백여 미터가 초토화되어 있었다.

findings.current: I had expected a certain degree of cunning, but the Arch Lich’s ruthlessness and audacity were beyond anything I had imagined.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the Arch Lich’s cunning with ruthlessness, altering the specific traits Jin is assessing.
findings.rationale: 교활함과 과감함 means “cunning and boldness”; ruthlessness is inferred from the situation but is not the trait named here.
findings.replacement: I had expected as much to some extent, but the Arch Lich’s cunning and boldness went beyond anything I had imagined.
findings.source: 어느 정도는 예상했지만, 아크 리치의 교활함과 과감함은 생각했던 것 이상이었다.

findings.defect: The past-perfect construction is temporally incoherent with “now” and produces unnatural English.
findings.rationale: The source directly connects the general benefit of vigilance to the present situation.

findings.current: I shot forward alongside the azure dragon’s roar, imbued with internal energy.
findings.defect: The modifier placement makes Jin, rather than the battle cry, appear to be imbued with internal energy and treats the roar awkwardly as a separate moving companion.
findings.rationale: 공력을 실은 modifies 창룡후: Jin releases the battle cry with internal energy as he launches forward.
findings.replacement: With an azure dragon’s roar charged with internal energy, I shot forward.
findings.source: 나는 공력을 실은 창룡후(蒼龍吼)와 함께 쏘아졌다.

findings.current: A muffled roar reverberated across the battlefield.
findings.defect: “Muffled” understates a shout powerful enough to shake the battlefield.
findings.rationale: 먹먹한 here conveys an overwhelming, ear-numbing quality, reinforced by 전장을 떨어 울리는.
findings.replacement: A deafening roar shook the battlefield.

findings.current: And yet, because of that insignificant human, it had lost both its greatest asset and a precious amount of magic power.
findings.defect: “Magic power” is inconsistent with the required mana terminology and “a precious amount” is an unnatural collocation.
findings.rationale: 마력 is mana in this setting, while 날리게 되었다 conveys losing or wasting it.
findings.replacement: And yet, because of that insignificant human, it had lost its greatest asset and wasted precious mana.
findings.source: 하지만 최고의 전력과 더불어 아까운 마력만 날리게 되었다. 저 하찮은 인간 때문에.

findings.current: An ogre that had become undead while still half-rotten staggered, only for a sword flying in from behind to slice off its upper body.
findings.defect: The draft changes the timing marker “following immediately afterward” into a direction, falsely stating that the sword came from behind.
findings.rationale: 뒤이어 means “following after” or “a moment later,” not “from behind.”
findings.replacement: An ogre that had become undead while still half-rotten staggered, only for a sword that came flying a moment later to take off its upper body.
findings.source: 반쯤 부패한 상태로 언데드가 된 오우거는 몸을 휘청이다가 뒤이어 날아든 검에 상반신이 날아갔다.

findings.current: The spear I hurled with all my strength pierced six or seven monsters like skewered meat.
findings.defect: “Hurled” adds that Jin releases and throws his weapon, an action not stated by the source.
findings.rationale: 흩뿌린 describes the spear being vigorously wielded or sent sweeping outward; it does not state that Jin lets go of it.
findings.replacement: My spear lashed out with all my strength, skewering six or seven monsters like meat on a skewer.
findings.source: 힘껏 흩뿌린 창이 예닐곱 마리의 몬스터를 꼬치처럼 꿰뚫었다.

findings.current: The monsters had become stronger under the fog’s influence, but the fog also made it difficult for sight and sound to travel.
findings.defect: “Sight and sound to travel” is an unnatural literal rendering of impaired visibility and muffled sound.
findings.rationale: 시야와 소리가 잘 전달되지 않는다 describes restricted visibility and sound transmission.
findings.replacement: The monsters becoming stronger under the fog’s influence was bad enough, but in fog this thick, visibility was limited and sound did not carry well.
findings.source: 안개의 영향으로 몬스터가 강해진 것도 문제였지만, 지금 같은 안개 속에서는 시야와 소리가 잘 전달되지 않는다.

findings.current: Human. By my lord’s command, I shall take your life.
findings.defect: The draft changes the explicit object from the speaker’s own life to the human’s life.
findings.rationale: The supplied source says 내 목숨, literally “my life,” not 네 목숨, “your life.” Although the source wording is contextually surprising, the review must preserve its explicit subject and object.
findings.replacement: Human. By my lord’s command, I shall take my own life.
findings.source: 인간이여. 군주의 명에 따라 내 목숨을 거두겠노라.

findings.current:
I stared at the ten monsters.

No—the ten lunchboxes.

“The lunchbox delivery is here.”

“……”

“……”

Put those question marks away, you bastards.

*One Annihilation, coming up.*
findings.defect: The draft omits Jin’s trembling gaze, removes one of the three reactions, and strips the question marks from the remaining two, undermining both the apparent-fear reversal and the punchline that explicitly refers to those question marks.
findings.rationale: 떨리는 눈동자로 sets up Jin’s feigned fear or excitement, and the source contains three separate puzzled reactions whose visible question marks are required for the following joke.
findings.replacement:
With trembling eyes, I stared at the ten monsters.

No—the ten lunchboxes.

“The lunchbox delivery is here.”

“…?”

“…?”

“…?”

Put those question marks away, you bastards.

*One Annihilation, coming up.*
findings.source:
나는 떨리는 눈동자로 열 마리의 몬스터, 아니 도시락을 바라보았다.

“도시락 배달이 왔어요.”

“……?”

- ……?

- ……?

물음표 치워, 이 새끼들아.

일섬 나간다.

summary: Several actionable fidelity errors alter quantities, physical actions, characterization, and the final comedic beat.
